verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents Autumn returning a hosted checkout URL or redirecting customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page. The attach endpoint attaches plans, previewAttach shows charges before confirmation, and the customer portal is for managing existing subscriptions. These are adjacent features, not hosted checkout, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can redirect customers to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized checkout page without building my own payment UI
